description: Use this when someone wants research with real people, e.g. "Set up a study with 20 HR leaders about benefits budgets": it designs a study one step at a time, and nothing reaches anyone until gather_launch_study. The first call (no study_id) starts a new design and creates a draft study in your workspace; each step's answer returns study_id, step and what to do next. Pass that study_id on every later call to continue the same design. step "questions": GatherHQ asks for something missing (objective, audience, who qualifies); ask the person as written and send their answer in instructions. step "plan_ready": GatherHQ shares a link to a research plan and interview guide (GatherHQ's research team sees the plan too); send feedback in instructions to revise it, or, only when the person approves it, call again with approve true. GatherHQ then builds the interview and tries to set up its audience: when it can, the answer has a test link; when GatherHQ's research team has to finish the targeting, the answer says so and has no test link yet, so check on the study later with gather_list_studies. step "built": done; nothing goes to real people until gather_launch_study.

approve.description: true only when the person has approved the research plan and interview guide (step "plan_ready").

instructions.description: The person's request, answer, feedback or approval, in their words.

study_id.description: The study_id from the design's earlier answers, to continue it. Leave out to start a new design.

name: gather_design_study
title: Design a research study
